capabilities: Insert citations from the EndNote library with @ autocomplete and a search dialog
Render live CSL-formatted citations and auto-updating bibliography blocks in notes
Search and browse the EndNote library, groups, and records in a sidebar
Export notes to .docx, LaTeX/BibTeX, or CSL-JSON using pandoc
Produce Word documents with real EndNote ADDIN EN.CITE fields via Word and the Cite While You Write add-in
extras: Desktop Obsidian 1.5+ only (Node APIs); mobile unsupported. Manual install by copying plugin files into .obsidian/plugins. Detailed disclosures: no network traffic, .enl opened read-only outside the vault, shell used only for exports (pandoc, PowerShell/Word COM).
intentEvidence: An Obsidian take on EndNote's Word add-in: the library is read straight out of EndNote's own .enl database
motivation: An Obsidian take on EndNote's Word add-in: the library is read straight out of EndNote's own .enl database, so nothing has to be exported by hand.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in citation tooling, and using an EndNote library normally means exporting references by hand instead of citing directly while writing.

relations.evidence: Opens .enl files read-only (they are SQLite under the hood) and reloads automatically whenever EndNote saves.
hands the document to Word + EndNote so they write real ADDIN EN.CITE fields

requires.name: pandoc on PATH for Word/LaTeX export
Microsoft Word desktop with the Cite While You Write add-in

summary: Citation plugin that reads an EndNote .enl library for autocomplete citing, live CSL-formatted citations, and Word/LaTeX export via pandoc.
